input:
I need to print a claim summary for one of our policyholders — it’s for internal review and must include all payments, reserves, and attached supplier details, as per our audit protocol.
The user cannot generate a claim summary that includes all payments, reserves, and supplier details for audit purposes.

I’m trying to pull a full claim summary for a policyholder and need to print it out for our internal file — can you help me find where that’s configured?
The user cannot locate where to configure printing of a full claim summary.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it?
The user cannot reset their password for the claims portal.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders.
The user cannot access the documents section because they need to reset their password.

Yes, the letters tab is greyed out too, and I can’t assign new tasks to my team since the roles aren’t syncing properly.
Roles are not syncing, causing the letters tab to be disabled and preventing task assignment.

I just spent 45 minutes ticking boxes for one person. If I could copy an existing role, it’d save hours every week. It’s frustrating that I can’t just duplicate an existing role — I have to manually select permissions for each new user, and if I make a mistake, it locks them out of their tasks.
Users cannot duplicate existing roles, forcing them to manually set permissions for each new user.

we’ve had issues with supplier letters not triggering automatically, and it’s causing delays in task assignments.
Supplier letters are not triggering automatically, which delays task assignments.

Do you know if the printed version includes supplier details too, or just policyholder and reserve info?
The printed claim summary may not include supplier details, and the customer is unsure if they are included.

Can you walk me through how to upload claims documents and assign them to the correct reserves?
The user does not know how to upload claim documents and assign them to the correct reserves.

we’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time.
The platform cannot verify third-party bank details before processing claims, causing payment delays.

we’re getting complaints because our letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing confusion
Letters to joint policyholders only display one name, leading to confusion.

I think my login credentials expired. Can you help me reset them?
The user cannot log in because their credentials have expired.

One thing we’ve struggled with is payment detail checking — it’s causing delays.
Payment detail checking is cumbersome and causing delays.

The issue is we can’t copy access roles — each new user needs permissions manually assigned, and one mistake blocks them entirely.
Admins cannot copy access roles, forcing manual permission assignment for each new user and causing errors that block access.

That’d be a huge help — our policyholders are starting to notice the delays.
Policyholders are experiencing delays in claim processing.

I’m trying to get our purchase order number updated on your latest invoice — it’s currently wrong...
The invoice displays an incorrect purchase order number.

I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently.
The user is locked out of the claims portal and cannot log in because they need a password reset.

it’s taking forever to assign permissions. Each person needs a custom setup and I keep worrying I’ll miss something.
Assigning permissions for a new claims team is slow and feels error‑prone.

I can’t just copy the permissions from our existing role, so I’m ... having to click ... for each person ... terrified I’ll lock ... out by accident.
Users cannot copy permissions from an existing role, forcing them to manually set each permission.

Claims: click "Open"...Claims: click "Save", rage x3
The user cannot save a claim after opening it.

we’re keen to streamline how we handle claims and documents across our team
The current claims and document handling process is not streamlined across the team.

can we adjust the roles so our junior staff can’t initiate payments without approval? We’ve had a couple of close calls.
Junior staff can currently initiate payments without required approval.

Claims: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
The Save button in the Claims section is not functioning correctly, causing user frustration.

I’ve pulled the supplier payments but the reserves still don’t align with what’s recorded.
The reserves do not align with the recorded amounts after pulling supplier payments.

we’ve got a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays
Recurring delays due to third‑party payee account verification.

We’re getting complaints because the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names, and customers are understandably upset.
The system fails to merge both joint policyholder names, displaying only one name.

noticed quite a few that haven’t moved in months—could we get those bulk‑closed to clean up the dashboard?
The platform does not allow bulk‑closing of inactive tasks.

Administration: click "Permission", rage x5
The user cannot find or use the permission settings in the administration section.

Perfect. We also need clean integrations with our supplier portals — can your system pull in supplier data without breaking our existing reporting?
Need clean integration with supplier portals to pull in supplier data without breaking existing reporting.

Thanks — just let me know when you’ve got a fix or workaround.
The customer is encountering an issue that needs a fix or workaround.

We’re getting complaints because when there are joint policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes only showing one or the wrong one, and it’s causing real issues with policyholders.
The system merges joint policyholder names incorrectly, often showing only one or the wrong name.

We can’t verify bank details ahead of time, which causes bounces.
The platform cannot verify third‑party bank details before processing payments, leading to bounced transactions.

I need to reset my password ... I’m locked out of the claims dashboard and can’t access policyholder documents.
The user cannot log in to the claims dashboard because they are locked out.

we need something that doesn’t force us to change how we work.
The product forces users to change their existing workflow.

we’ve been struggling with some payment ... delays lately.
Payments are being delayed within the platform.

I’m trying to filter tasks by due date because we’ve got multiple claims coming up and I need to prioritize them before the next reporting cycle.
The platform does not provide a way to filter tasks by due date.

the permissions system is causing delays — it’s tedious and error-prone
The permissions system is tedious and error‑prone, causing delays when setting up a new claims team.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
The Save button on the Reports page is causing frustration and likely not functioning correctly.

Perfect — we’ve had issues with permissions before. Can you show how roles are assigned during setup?
The customer experiences permission issues and needs guidance on assigning roles during setup.

it’s so easy to ... someone ... gets locked out.
The permissions setup process is confusing and error‑prone, leading to users being accidentally locked out.

are there any upcoming updates to the suppliers section? We’re hoping to streamline our vendor payments soon.
The current suppliers section does not support streamlined vendor payments.

can we export our case notes as PDFs? ... we need to be able to export notes as PDF for compliance and internal review
Customers cannot export case notes as PDFs for audit and compliance purposes.

I’m having trouble pulling up the latest reserves report for our marine cargo claims.
The user cannot retrieve the latest reserves report for marine cargo claims.

We’ve also noticed that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting our supplier timelines.
Payee account verification is not performed before funds are released, leading to re‑issuance delays and supplier timeline issues.

can we adjust roles so only senior handlers see the integrations tab? It’s causing confusion.
Users cannot limit the integrations tab to senior handlers, causing confusion for other users.

Right now, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later. We’re currently facing delays because we can’t validate third-party bank details before sending payments — that’s why we’re reissuing them days later, and payment detail checking is the core issue.
Customers cannot verify third‑party bank information before issuing payments, leading to bounced payments and re‑issues.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard anymore.
The customer cannot access the claims dashboard because they need to reset their password.

Appreciate you taking this seriously — we’ve had three complaints this month just because the joint policyholder names weren’t merged correctly.
Joint policyholder names are not being merged correctly, leading to complaints.

We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
Letters to joint policyholders only display one name, causing complaints.

can we discuss how policyholders receive automated letters? Some aren’t getting them.
Policyholders are not receiving automated letters.

We’ve had too many delays from payment detail checking.
Delays in payment detail checking are slowing down claim processing.

I’ve been reviewing the claims workflow and need to clarify how reserves tie into supplier payments.
The customer is unclear how reserves are linked to supplier payments in the claims workflow.

We’ve been waiting for that feature to reduce manual work on reserves and supplier reconciliations.
The product lacks a feature to automate reserves and supplier reconciliations, forcing manual work.

can you confirm whether the letters module supports custom templates for policyholder notifications?
The customer is unsure if the letters module allows custom templates for policyholder notifications.

I’m reaching out because we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.
Customers cannot update the purchase order reference on an invoice, causing reconciliation issues.

We’ve got a few joint policyholder cases where the letters are coming out with mismatched names—causing complaints.
Letters generated for joint policyholder cases have mismatched names.

I’m trying to pull the latest reserves report for Brackwater Homecover but the system’s throwing an error when I filter by supplier payments.
The system errors when filtering the reserves report by supplier payments.

The issue with letters merging multiple names on letters is causing us real problems — clients are complaining because only one name shows up, and sometimes it’s not even the right one.
When letters merge multiple names, only one name appears—often the wrong one—leading to client complaints and loss of trust.

Claim details: click "Next"...Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
The claim details page requires multiple clicks and causes frustration.

Administration: click "Permission", rage x5
The permission setting process is frustrating because it requires multiple clicks.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest supplier payment against our claims reserves and I’m not sure if I’m updating the figures correctly.
The user is unsure how to correctly update figures when reconciling a supplier payment against claims reserves.

I’m having trouble assigning roles ... on our claims dashboard.
User cannot assign roles to new team members on the claims dashboard.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
The Save button on the Reports page is causing frustration and likely not functioning correctly.

we’ve been having some trouble with joint policyholder names in outgoing letters
The system mishandles joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.
